{{Quote|Lady Valarian needs this revised proclamation to be delivered to her advocate just outside of town. He's an Ithorian... named Ysho... shouldn't be hard to find.|[[Kavas Urdano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KU" />}}
'''Ysho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was the advocate of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian criminal syndicate]] on Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:KU" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Lady Valarian's lieutenant [[Kavas Urdano]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with delivering an official proclamation to Ysho in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The spacer and the Ithorian were then attacked by three henchmen working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], Valarian's main rival, but the spacer killed them all and successfully defended Ysho.<ref name="SWG:KU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ysho was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ysho was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:KU" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Ysho was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
